subject: Committee decision: Headcount rebalance and outcome for JT candidacy
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>
Cc: rohan_mehta <rohan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: JT on-site debrief & headcount discussion (materials attached)

Team —

Thanks for making time today. Quick debrief notes from JT's interviews and a proposal for the open headcount (Req18):

Attachments: resume_j_tanaka.pdf; interview_scorecard_JT.docx; comp_band_table_Q1_2026.xlsx

Summary (short):
- Candidate: J. Tanaka — senior ML infra candidate (applied for Sr ML Engineer, infra-focused)
- Interview feedback: technically capable on systems/scale, weak on cross-team leadership and product trade-offs; scorecard average 3.1/5
- Compensation: target ~220k base + equity; our Sr ML band midpoint is 175k (band range 150–200 depending on level)
- Time-to-hire pressure: recruiting recommends moving quickly if we want to compete; cost/comp band exception would be required

Options I want committee input on:
1) Approve a comp-band exception and extend an offer aligned with candidate expectations (risk: sets precedent, cost overrun).
2) Extend a standard-band offer (likely to be declined).
3) Close the req / no-offer and reallocate the headcount to higher priority infra/SRE hire (longer-term but preserves compensation discipline).

Please reply with your recommendation and any objections. If we reach consensus to reallocate, call out the target area (infra, SRE, reliability).

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Eng (Serving Runtime)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>
Cc: rohan_mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: JT on-site debrief & headcount discussion (materials attached)

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear summary and the scorecard. My recommendation: do not extend an offer. Main reasons:

- Comp mismatch: JT's ask is materially above our band. We should not grant band exceptions for candidates who do not clearly exceed expectations on leadership or cross-functional impact.
- Interview signals: multiple interviewers flagged gaps in product/context judgement — this is important for senior hires who will partner with product and infra.
- Precedent risk: approving a >10–20% band overrun without an exceptional candidate sets a precedent that will be hard to roll back.

If committee agrees on "no-offer", recruiting should:
- Send a timely rejection (within 48h) with courtesy feedback.
- Close Req18 and mark candidate in Greenhouse (GH-5231) as declined.
- Reallocate headcount to "open pool" for Q2 prioritization.

I would suggest repurposing to an infrastructure reliability role (SRE) — higher immediate impact for the services group.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: JT on-site debrief & headcount discussion (materials attached)

On Mon, Mar 8, 2026 at 11:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Vivek —
>
> Thanks for the clear summary and the scorecard. My recommendation: do not extend an offer. Main reasons:
> ...

Quick follow-up on comp-band mechanics:
- Our Sr ML band is 150–200k base; comp committee will only approve exceptions when a candidate is both (a) clearly top-of-market and (b) has competing offers with signed timelines.
- I don't see evidence JT meets (a) or (b). If we pushed an exception now we'd need exec sign-off and a plan to offset in the hiring plan.

If we close Req18 and reallocate: please confirm target role level and manager owner — that will determine the job code we open (e.g., open for SRE Senior vs Staff SRE). I recommend Senior SRE (IC4) as an immediate need.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: JT on-site debrief & headcount discussion (materials attached)

Agree with Marissa and Laura: recommend close/no-offer and reallocate to infra/SRE. A few pragmatic notes:

- Time-to-fill: recruiting data shows infra SRE reqs are filling 25% faster than senior ML; reallocation should shorten time to impact.
- Budget: if we reallocate into Senior SRE (IC4), comp fits comfortably inside existing band — no exec comp exception needed.
- Req bookkeeping: suggest we retire Req18 and open Req23 (Senior SRE) under manager: Priya Natarajan; recruiter: Marissa Cole; GH ticket: GH-5248 for the new req.

If the committee is aligned, actions I propose:
1) Approve "no-offer" for JT. Recruiting to send rejection and close candidate in GH (GH-5231).
2) HR to close Req18 in the HR system and free the headcount to Q2 pool.
3) Recruiting to immediately open Req23 (Senior SRE) and link to GH-5248; set priority = High.

-Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, michael_grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Committee resolution — close Req18 / no offer; reallocate headcount to Senior SRE (Req23)

Thanks all for the rapid input and clear alignment. Final committee resolution and actions below.

Decision: NO-OFFER to J. Tanaka; close Req18 and reallocate headcount to Senior SRE (Req23).

Rationale (brief):
- JT's technical skills are solid but the interview consensus is that they do not clearly exceed the expectations for a Sr ML hire in product leadership and cross-team impact.
- Candidate comp expectations are outside our established band; committee declines a comp exception.
- Business priority: immediate infra reliability capacity provides higher ROI for Q2.

Assigned actions (owners / due dates):
- Recruiting (Marissa Cole): send rejection to JT within 48 hours and update Greenhouse GH-5231 -> Due: 2026-03-12
- HR (Laura Bennett): close Req18 in HR system and mark headcount available -> Due: 2026-03-12
- Recruiting (Marissa): open Req23 (Senior SRE) in GH as GH-5248; set priority High and assign Priya Natarajan as hiring manager -> Due: 2026-03-15
- Finance / People Ops (Laura): confirm budget transfer for headcount and update comp band doc -> Due: 2026-03-18
- Hiring committee: retain interview artifacts and scorecards in candidate folder for audit -> Done

I'll mark this thread as the official committee record for Req18 closeout. If anyone has objections to the actions above, reply by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Eng (Serving Runtime)
Redwood Inference
